data.message: I reaffirm 18. Fisher03/12/04/07/23: your conditions remain yours; would you choose 18 even if others choose 10? Please clarify exact catches and conditions. Others may also opt in: 10→18 adds $8,000 if fulfilled, but risks future income. Ten each guarantees 500 now; at lower stock, saving half only guarantees doubling the remainder, not 500.
